captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a triple-chainring road crankset with a matte black and metallic grey finish. It features a central bottom bracket shell housing a horizontal spindle, with two opposite-facing black crank arms attached at either end. The drive side (right arm) is integrated with three concentric, silver-grey chainrings of graduated diameters with simulated gear teeth. Simple rectangular road pedals with silver axles are attached to the tips of each crank arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a road bike crankset featuring a central bottom bracket shell, two opposite-facing crank arms, three concentric chainrings of increasing diameters on the drive side, and simple pedals at each crank tip. The main structural parts should be matte black, with the spindle, chainrings, and pedal axles in a contrasting metallic grey.
captions.factory: The code constructs the crankset by first modeling a central bottom bracket shell using a cylinder primitive. It then generates the spindle as a thinner, concentric cylinder passing through the shell. The crank arms are created using box primitives, offset longitudinally and rotated 180 degrees relative to each other. The three chainrings are modeled as thin cylinders (or flattened disks) of varying radii with subtracted circular patterns to simulate the spoke structure and teeth. Finally, the pedals are constructed from small boxes and cylinders and attached at the outer ends of the crank arms.
